title: Read the Route: Attention-Steered Hypergraph Retrieval for Multi-hop RAG
abstract: arXiv:2610.35412v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Graph-based retrieval-augmented generation (GraphRAG) answers multi-hop questions by organizing a corpus into a graph and retrieving along its structure. Existing retrieval methods face two limitations. Diffusion- and similarity-based methods expand retrieval along fixed edge weights or by similarity to the question, without resolving its implicit entity references, allowing relevance errors to accumulate across hops. In contrast, exploration-based methods let an LLM reason about the next hop, but require a separate generation at each hop, leading to high inference costs. We observe that an LLM can resolve implicit entity references from retrieved passages and a multi-hop question before generating any tokens. Further analysis identifies a small set of attention heads, termed addressing heads, that capture this capability across multiple hops in a single forward pass. Building on this finding, we propose HyperAddress, which runs Personal

translated_title: 读懂路线：面向多跳RAG的注意力引导超图检索
translated_abstract: 基于图的检索增强生成通过将语料库组织成图并沿其结构进行检索，来回答多跳问题。现有检索方法面临两个局限：基于扩散和相似度的方法沿固定的边权重或依据与问题的相似度进行检索扩展，却无法解析问题中的隐式实体引用，导致相关性误差在多跳过程中不断累积；而基于探索的方法让大语言模型推理下一跳，但每一跳都需要单独进行一次生成，造成高昂的推理成本。我们观察到，大语言模型在生成任何文本之前，就能够从检索到的段落和多跳问题中解析出隐式实体引用。进一步分析发现，存在一小组注意力头（称为“寻址头”），它们能够在单次前向传播中捕获跨多个跳数的这种能力。基于这一发现，我们提出了HyperAddress，它运行个性化（PageRank）……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 该论文发现大语言模型中存在能于单次前向传播中跨多跳解析隐式实体引用的“寻址头”注意力头，并据此提出注意力引导的超图检索方法HyperAddress，以低推理成本实现准确的多跳RAG检索。
